title: Terms of use
section: What the license asks of you
text:
What the license asks of you

Credit WFRC and link to the source. For example: Wasatch Front Regional Council. (2026). [Tool name] [Online tool]. https://example.org/tool/
Say if you changed the material. Describe what you changed, and keep any earlier notes about changes that you find. A changed version must never be presented as WFRC’s own. For example: “Based on WFRC’s [Tool name] (2026). Modified by [organization]: [what changed].”
Do not suggest that WFRC endorses you or your use.

These conditions apply to results from our tools and models as well as to the pages and maps themselves.

text:
What the license does not cover

Data from other sources. Each provider’s copyright and terms apply, and you must follow them if you reuse it. Check the provider before you republish, redistribute or build a product on it.
Models. They are shared under the release letter, not under CC BY 4.0.
Source code. Each repository has its own license file.
